overview: LIV Oceanside stands as a symbol of premium waterfront living in Dubai, offering an extraordinary collection of residences that redefine coastal sophistication. Developed by LIV Developers, this exclusive project on Dubai Islands presents a unique opportunity to enjoy marina-side living with breathtaking sea views from every home. With uninterrupted vistas stretching across the horizon, LIV Oceanside captures the essence of serene island living while staying seamlessly connected to Dubai’s lively urban core.
